sources.citation: Thomassen, Marius. 2015. [Bonke Gamo phonology] MA thesis, University of Oslo (held under../gamo1243/)
sources.note: About Gamo, not Dorze: reviews Hayward 1994 and Hayward & Chabo 2014 (Gamo as a 'tonal accent' language, H associated with the first accented mora, default on the stem-final syllable) and argues instead for a simple tone analysis. Mentions Dorze only as a North Ometo language / a regional Gamo variety in Hirut Woldemariam's (2004:76) tree.

sources.citation: Abel Birku. 2010. The Syllable Structure and Syllable Based Morphophonemic Processes in Dorze: Representations Based on Moraic Phonology. MA thesis, Department of Linguistics, Addis Ababa University. 99 pp. (etd.aau.edu.et item 12345678/22910)
sources.note: Nothing on placement; explicitly out of scope. Sec. 1.6 (p.5): Haile Eyesus 1981 'treated suprasegmental features like stress and intonation, but my study was limited to the syllable'. Conclusion (p.70, PDF p.81): 'syllable can serve as a domain of stress, it is not explored in this study... Further consideration even whether or not Dorze is a stress or a tonal language would be of interest.' No accent/tone marks in transcriptions.
